Hear what the Lord in vision said
Hear what the Lord in vision said,
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 89:19–52, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
Hear what the Lord in vision said, And made his mercy known: "Sinners, behold your help is laid "On my almighty Son. STANZA I
Watts's psalms run from Psalm 1 to Psalm 150, several settings to many psalms: 367 hymns. This is number 5. Point at a tick to see the hymn; click it to open that hymn.
